description: Arm three of the ordered EVALUATE TRUE in PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:117-151. EIBCALEN is 160 so :82 copies the commarea; CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives as 1, which makes NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :83 false, so :89 RECEIVEs the map and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :90-103 routes DFHENTER to PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :91-92. FNAMEI and LNAMEI are populated so arms one and two at :118-129 cannot match, USERIDI is eight spaces so :130 matches, and the first matching WHEN wins: :131 raises WS-ERR-FLG, :132-133 moves 'User ID can NOT be empty...' to WS-MESSAGE, :134 moves -1 to USERIDL and :135 sends. The item is USERIDI, not the USRIDINI of COUSR02 and COUSR03, which are different screens. USERIDL is stated as the cursor because COBOL positions the cursor by moving -1 into the length item, and that item is COMP PIC S9(4) metadata, never a payload member. SPACES and LOW-VALUES are not interchangeable, and conflating them is the easiest mistake on this screen: :130 tests 'SPACES OR LOW-VALUES' so both limbs reach this arm, and this case drives the SPACES limb by sending eight blanks where an omitted item would drive the LOW-VALUES limb instead. That is a separate question from what the program paints - MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COUSR1AO at :85 fills the output map with x'00' on first entry, while MOVE SPACES at :290-294 fills those same five data fields with x'20' after the PF4 clear at :96-97 - and the two are different observables. Nothing is written: the flag raised at :131 makes IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON at :153 false, so the five MOVEs at :154-158 and WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE at :238-248 are unreachable. The eight-space USERIDI never becomes a SEC-USR-ID, expectedWrites is empty, and expectedFinalState states all ten seeded rows at eighty bytes each, so the absence of an eleventh row is asserted rather than assumed. The five data fields echo what arrived, because INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS at :287-295 runs only from the NORMAL write arm at :252 and from the PF4 clear at :281. Nothing is highlighted: COPY DFHATTR. at :57 is commented out, COUSR01C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY, and MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at :254 is the only attribute assignment anywhere in the program - so there is no '*' marker, no per-field DFHRED, and ERRMSGC keeps DFHDFCOL, under which the map's own COLOR=RED at app/bms/COUSR01.bms:151-154 is what renders. SEND-USRADD-SCREEN at :184-196 repaints all six header fields through POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :214-233 and then moves WS-MESSAGE into ERRMSGO at :188; both channels are stated, the eighty bytes of WS-MESSAGE and the seventy-eight of the screen field, because that right-truncating MOVE is exactly where two bytes go missing silently. MAIN-PARA ends at EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID COMMAREA at :107-110, so the termination is RETURN_TRANSID, the conversation stays on CU01 / COUSR01C / COUSR01 / COUSR1A, and the commarea travels back in the payload byte for byte - this path writes no commarea field, and no session, cache or static field holds it. jobParameters is declared and empty because an online transaction takes no JCL PARM. USRSEC is seeded from app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:L35-L44 at the fifty-seven characters the JCL carries rather than pre-padded, because the 57-to-80 pad has exactly one owner: the declared USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation, applied at seed time and never at comparison time. SEC-USR-PWD stays an eight-character plaintext span exactly as the source compares it, and the charset is named US-ASCII rather than left to a platform default. PROVENANCE: every expected value here is statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:130-135, the arm this case governs, together with :73-76, :78-105, :107-110, :117-151, :153-160, :184-196, :214-233 and :238-274, cross-checked against app/cpy-bms/COUSR01.CPY for the xxxI and xxxO PICTURE widths 4/40/8/8/40/8/20/20/8/8/1/78, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:18-22 for the two forty-byte titles - CCDA-TITLE02's 'Credit Card Demo Application (CCDA)' literal is commented out, so 'CardDemo' is what ships - app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy for the mm/dd/yy and hh:mm:ss renderings, app/bms/COUSR01.bms:155-159 for the footer 'ENTER=Add User  F3=Back  F4=Clear  F12=Exit' that documents what each key means, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy for the 160-byte commarea, app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 for the record layout summed mechanically as 8+20+20+8+1+23=80, and app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:L35-L44 for the seed rows. They were NOT captured from a live COBOL execution: AAP 0.7.6 records eight independently verified blockers, among them no z/OS runtime, a compiler reporting 'indexed file handler : disabled', no Language Environment CEE* services, no CICS emulator, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository. Only the provenance is substituted; twenty cases, field-for-field diffing and a required diff count of zero all stand. The pinned clock 2022-07-19T23:12:34 is the source's own version stamp at app/cbl/COUSR01C.cbl:298, shared by all twenty cases of this folder so that no expectation depends on a wall clock.
